mapper.select: SELECT area.id AS search_area_id, op.incident_id, area.operational_period_id AS op_id, assignment.assigned_account_id, area.version AS search_area_version FROM search_area area JOIN operational_period op ON op.id = area.operational_period_id JOIN search_area_assignment assignment ON assignment.search_area_id = area.id AND assignment.status = 'ACTIVE' AND assignment.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN police_phone phone ON phone.account_id = assignment.assigned_account_id AND phone.status = 'ACTIVE' AND phone.registered = TRUE WHERE area.id = #{searchAreaId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND area.area_level = 'TEAM' AND area.status = 'ACTIVE' AND phone.id = #{policePhoneId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY assignment.assigned_at DESC, assignment.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_area_boundary_alert ( id, incident_id, operational_period_id, search_area_id, police_phone_id, search_path_id, alert_type, status, location, client_ts, server_received_at, version, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{opId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{searchAreaId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{policePhoneId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{searchPathId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{alertType}, #{status}, ST_GeomFromEWKT(#{location,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.JtsGeometryTypeHandler}), #{clientTs}, #{serverReceivedAt}, #{version}, #{createdAt} )
